token_recovery.subject: Radio Anarchy // Your Access Token & OBS Stream Link Recovery
token_recovery.body:
Hey {name},

We found your active subscription! Here are your credentials:

Access Token: {token}
Personal OBS Link: https://radio.radioanarchy.gg/?token={token}

To hook it into OBS:
1. Add a Browser Source.
2. Paste your Personal OBS Link.
3. Width: 680, Height: 480.
4. Check 'Control audio via OBS' to get a dedicated mixer fader.

Let us know if you need anything else!
-- Gumbus the Cat, Radio Anarchy Operations

obs_audio_monitoring_help.subject: Radio Anarchy Support // OBS Browser Source Audio Setup
obs_audio_monitoring_help.body:
Hey {name},

If you see the player playing but don't hear sound in your headphones:

1. In OBS, right-click the Browser Source -> Properties.
2. Ensure 'Control audio via OBS' is CHECKED.
3. In your OBS Audio Mixer dock, click the gear/three dots next to 'Radio Anarchy' -> 'Advanced Audio Properties'.
4. Find the Radio Anarchy source and change 'Audio Monitoring' from 'Monitor Off' to 'Monitor and Output' (this sends audio to both your headphones and your stream!).

You should be rockin' immediately after that!
-- Gumbus the Cat

dmca_clearance_proof.subject: Radio Anarchy // Commercial Clearance & DMCA Whitelist Statement
dmca_clearance_proof.body:
Hey {name},

All music streamed through Radio Anarchy is 100% royalty-free and commercially licensed for Twitch, YouTube, Kick, and podcast live broadcasting.

If you ever receive an automated claim or Content ID notification:
1. Dispute the claim with the reason: 'Commercially cleared license via Radio Anarchy Streaming (Order ref: {token})'.
2. The tracks are pre-whitelisted and claims are automatically released.

Keep streaming loud and clear!
-- Radio Anarchy Legal & Operations
